links.outcome: Accuracy of LLMs versus experienced urologists and medical students on the same urology questions
links.effect: All five AI models had significantly higher odds of correct answers than experienced urologists (all p < 0.001, Dunnett-adjusted); medical students did not differ significantly from urologists.
links.quote: In the model-adjusted analysis, all five AI models showed significantly higher odds of correct answers than experienced urologists (all p < 0.001, Dunnett-adjusted), while medical students did not differ significantly from urologists.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance of five reasoning LLMs on urology-focused multiple-choice questions from the MedQA benchmark against medical students and urologists, without evaluating a deployment guardrail or workflow intervention.
